---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible correctness, integration or documentation defect.
---

Use [private reporting](https://github.com/dugan-dev/UniMemory/security/advisories/new) for vulnerabilities. Remove secrets and private application data from examples and logs.

## Revision and environment

- Commit or source snapshot (the 0.0.1 version alone is insufficient):
- OS, architecture, compiler, standard library and runtime:
- Backend and native dependency versions:
- Static/shared, Debug/Release, statistics and sanitizer settings:

## Reproducer

Provide the smallest complete program or project, configure/build/run commands, expected behavior and actual output. For lifetime problems, show how Memory, buffers, owners and weak references are created and destroyed.

## Evidence

Attach relevant text logs and the failing test or compiler diagnostic. For a language-contract finding, cite the applicable standard wording; distinguish it from an observed runtime failure. State which other configurations were checked and any limitations.
